title: Jökulsárlón: 25‑km Glacier Lagoon Glow

scenes.query: Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon 25 km glacier lagoon icebergs
scenes.text: 25 km of blue icebergs drift endlessly…

scenes.query: Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon 1.4 km glacier lagoon

scenes.text: It receives around 300,000 metric tonnes of ice each year from the Breiðamerkurjökull glacier.
